landing.heroDescription: For Brockenhäuser, refurbishers, vintage shops, and repair workshops. Track intake, grade condition, price flexibly, and measure your impact — with AI that understands secondhand.
landing.featureIntakeDesc: Log donations and trade-ins in seconds. Generate donation receipts. Track where every item came from.
landing.featureConditionDesc: Grade items, route to repair or sale, track every step from arrival to sold. Per-item lifecycle tracking.
landing.featurePricingDesc: Guide prices that buyers can adjust. Condition-based pricing. Because secondhand isn't one-size-fits-all.
landing.featureImpactDesc: Devices saved, CO2 avoided, people served. Generate impact reports for your Vereinsbericht automatically.
landing.featureAiDesc: Type '50 laptops donated by Swisscom' and the system does the right thing. Create intakes, invoices, and reports in plain language.
landing.featureSwissDesc: QR-bills, VAT rates, Rappen rounding, CAMT bank import, Swiss chart of accounts. Not adapted — built for Switzerland.
landing.step1Desc: Items arrive as donations, trade-ins, or purchases. Log the intake, record the donor, and items enter your pipeline.
landing.step2Desc: Assess condition, route to repair or direct sale. AI suggests prices based on model and condition. You decide.
landing.step3Desc: Invoice with QR-bills, reconcile payments automatically, and watch your impact dashboard grow.
landing.readyToStart: Ready to give things a second life?
landing.joinCommunity: Join the secondhand businesses that track every item from intake to impact.
